name: Optic
classification_notes: Modular geometric sans-serif with deliberately uneven strokes evoking hand-carved letterforms. Blocky proportions and rounded terminals give it a display-first character that sits between structured geometry and raw expressionism.
summary: A carved-block geometric sans in three widths and six weights, bold but light-hearted.
description: Optic is a geometric sans-serif built on modular block forms that evoke letters chiselled from stone. Deliberately uneven strokes and rounded terminals balance structural firmness with a playful, almost hand-made quality. Three widths and six weights with matching italics make it well-suited to advertising, packaging and editorial display.
foundry_blurb: Sanfilippo describes Optic as tough on the inside and soft on the outside – a bold yet light-hearted design where each letter appears carved from a block of rock, giving the typeface a natural, raw quality suited to advertising, packaging, branding and children's publishing.
